cell_1.name: cell
cell_1.description: You are in a small, dank dungeon cell with a door facing north and a simple straw mattress.

cell_2.name: cell
cell_2.description: You are in a dirty dungeon cell even smaller than the first, but you don't see any furniture. This cell also has a wooden door facing north.

gallery.name: gallery
gallery.description: You are in a medium-length gallery with two doors on the south wall, one on the left, one on the right. There is an open doorway leading north, and an open doorway leading east.

guardroom.name: guardroom
guardroom.description: You are in a large foyer-style room with a big desk in the center, a shelf against the west wall, and sprawling landscape painting hanging from the north wall.

armory.name: armory
armory.description: You are in a dimly lit storage room with several sets of armor hanging on mannequins against the north wall. There is a weapon rack next to it, and in the northwest corner there is what appears to be a torture table.
